messages:
nina.r: Pushing 2026.03.23-rcA for ranking-service. Targeting tonight's change window (2026-03-23 23:45 UTC). Includes: ranker model bump, feature-flag ff_rank_v3 retire, small config tweak. Pinning artifact now.

dan.t: Ack. Release notes draft: https://internal.docs/releases/2026-03-23-rcA (added rollback steps & ff impact). DB no-op.

sre-mike: KV/cache warm recommended for leaderboard + user-sim endpoints. Suggest warm at T-15m, smoke at T-5m. I'll be on-call/sheriff for first 20m.

pm-anna: PM sign-off: customers in beta already notified. Ensure rollback plan re-enables ff_rank_v3 and reverts to 2026.03.10-stable.

nina.r: Rollback commands: `deployctl promote --svc=ranker --version=2026.03.10-stable` and `ffctl set ff_rank_v3 on --env=prod`. Rollback triggers: >1% 5xx for 5m, or relevance regression >3pt on canary eval.

dan.t: Ops note: need to coordinate edge cache purge after full promote. Schedule purge at +10m post-100%.

sre-mike: Observability: increasing trace sampling for canary, short-lived alert on P50/P95 latency drift. Will mute infra noise.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by nina.r for 2026-03-23T23:45:00Z. Artifact pinned: 2026.03.23-rcA. Plan: pin -> kv-warm -> smoke -> canary(3%,25%,100%) -> post-promote ff toggle. To abort: `deploy-bot cancel 3776549999`.

nina.r: Added 10m pre-promo quiet window for any last-minute hotfixes. If you need to abort say "hold promo" in this thread.

dan.t: Preflight smoke script: `curl -fsS https://staging.ranker.internal/health | jq -r .ok` returns true. Add to pipeline.

pm-anna: Quick ask: document customer-impact blurb for release notes (404s? session resets?). I added a line about a transient cache miss possibility.

sre-mike: Scheduling KV warm at 23:30, smoke at 23:40 per timeline. I'll run `POST /internal/warm?svc=ranker&artifact=2026.03.23-rcA` and report back.

(deploy-bot): KV warm scheduled 2026-03-23T23:30:00Z. Smoke scheduled 2026-03-23T23:40:00Z. Canary start: 2026-03-23T23:45:00Z.

(nina.r): Hold promo — seeing flaky e2e on session cookie during final test. Investigating.

sre-mike: Acknowledged hold. Pausing scheduled actions. Standing by.

dan.t: small repro: session cookie missing when edge cookie ttl set to 0 in conf. Likely config drift.

nina.r: I've pushed a quick config revert to staging, rerun smoke.

pm-anna: thumbs up on revert, let us know when green.

sre-mike: Smoke passed on staging. Ready to resume. If all good I'll kick off KV warm again and proceed.

nina.r: Resume and proceed. deploy-bot, resume schedule and run pinned artifact.

deploy-bot: Resume confirmed. Executing: pin -> kv-warm -> smoke -> canary. Good luck! :rocket:

sre-mike: KV warm done, initial traces look healthy. Starting 3% canary now. Monitoring 10m.

(nina.r): 3% canary healthy after 10m. Promoting to 25% now.

sre-mike: 25% healthy after 10m. No regressions on canary eval. Proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete. Post-promote task: toggling ff_rank_v3 -> OFF.

(nina.r): FF toggled off. Post-promote edge purge scheduled at +10m.

dan.t: Edge purge executed at +11m, traffic normalized. Closing thread soon.

pm-anna: Final sign-off: everything looks good. Added note to release summary about FF retirement and edge purge.

sre-mike: Leaving monitoring for another 20m then I'll hand off. No rollback needed.

(deploy-bot): Thread closed by deploy-bot. If you need to reopen use `deploy-bot reopen 3776549999`.
